captions.text: Let me say that again. Soy products reduce cancer risk.
The reason I wanna emphasize that is some people got the opposite idea.
They went online and they heard that soy products somehow cause breast cancer.
There are two different estrogen receptors.
Estrogen receptor alpha: when something attaches to that, you have a higher cancer risk.
That's like the gas pedal for cancer.
Estrogen receptor beta is different. It's the brake,
and that's where the soy isoflavones attach.
Women who consume it have less risk of breast cancer.
Men who consume soy have less risk of prostate cancer.
